name: Gravity Bomb, Mass
body:
School transmutation; Level magus 4, psychic 4, sorcerer/wizard 4

Targets one creature/2 levels, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart

DESCRIPTION

This functions as gravity bomb, except that it affects multiple creatures, the damage it deals each round is 1d6 + your spellcasting ability modifier, and it increases the bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage dealt to the target creature by any ranged attack or ranged spell by 4 points.
